conditions.renderer: Chromium 154 / ANGLE SwiftShader (software), no physical GPU
conditions.lighthouse: 13.6.0 desktop preset, provided throttling, active WebGL, separate sequential browser sessions
conditions.sampling: 6-second requested idle and cold-scroll windows; slow frames can extend the actual window. Same absolute scroll formula; editorial layouts differ.
conditions.hardwareGpuUtilizationReason: Not exposed by the software-rendered environment. CDP GPU-process CPU time is CPU, not hardware GPU utilization.
limitations: Single local measurements, with short software-renderer samples and host variability; no universal 60 FPS or physical-phone certification.
Cold scrolling remains slow and has variable frame times on SwiftShader; the measurements do not establish stable 60 FPS.
Per-program timer queries sample different geometry, resolutions and rendering paths. They are not an isolated same-shader A/B and must not be summed into frame time.

before.scope: TIME_ELAPSED_EXT around one WebGL draw; not a whole-frame timer
limits: SwiftShader is a software renderer. Its timer values do not certify physical GPU performance or utilization.
Program discovery and timer queries add instrumentation overhead; this run must stay separate from FPS/Lighthouse measurements.
One program can draw different geometries. Samples describe the observed draw calls, not isolated fragment-shader instruction cost.
Only programs active at the hero and its current quality tier are sampled. Unobserved inventory entries are not reported as zero cost.
Zero, disjoint, unavailable and timed-out query results are not treated as reliable zero-cost measurements.
